theorem Jq_bounds {x : ℝ} (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∈ Qset r₀) :
    0.63907 * mPhi q * x - 9.62e-4 * mPhi q * x - 3.6e-9 * x ≤
        ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ∫ y in arc 8 r₀ x q b, ‖S etaPlus x y‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ∫ y in arc 8 r₀ x q b, ‖S etaPlus x y‖ ^ 2 ≤
        0.64034 * mPhi q * x + 9.62e-4 * mPhi q * x + 2.17e-7 * x := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hr₀ : r₀ = 150000 := rfl

proof_context.conclusion: Per modulus $q$: $\sum_b\int_{J_{q,b}}|S_{\eta_+}|^2$ lies between $0.63907\,m_q x-9.62\cdot10^{-4}m_qx-3.6\cdot10^{-9}x$ and $0.64034\,m_qx+9.62\cdot10^{-4}m_qx+2.17\cdot10^{-7}x$, with $m_q=\mu^2(q)/\phi(q)$ (`mPhi q`); these error terms play the role of [H]'s error terms of Lemma 10.3.1.
